brief_title: Trending sound remix that turns a habit hack into a reveal
hook_spoken: I did not expect this habit hack to blow up.
hook_on_screen_text: I did NOT expect this to blow up

structure.beat: Creator reacts on camera while the trending sound sets the beat
Cuts to the habit hack itself, timed to the drop in the sound
Shows the app screen that makes the hack repeatable
Ends on the result with a link in bio card

product_or_topic_shown: A habit app, shown for a few seconds inside a trend format
why_it_worked: The trending sound bought the first two seconds and the hack paid them back. The comments ask for the link and ask whether it works long term, so the format sold the product and left one objection open.
transferable_mechanism: borrow a trending sound for reach, then spend the middle of the video on one concrete hack the product enables
adaptation_for_product: keep the trend timing but make the hack the five second Sprout check in, and answer the long term objection on screen
avoid: Copying the sound with a generic aesthetic montage and no hack at all
